quotes.text: I have full confidence and faith that what I'm looking at in the model is what I need to install. A big part of why people hesitate is because they're like, is this even accurate?

The design catches the construction and now you're totally shot. Instead of saving the owner money and speeding up the outcome, we're costing the job a bunch of money and unable to recover in the end.

The knowledge that you gain out there, nobody could ever take that from you, because that's the bread and butter of what we do, and having that in your back pocket is more valuable than anything downstream.
